arc_fake_player 3.5.4 validation (2026-10-25 Asia/Shanghai)

Python regression suite: 1116 checks passed across 12 files
(identity tests: stable synthetic xuid/uuid, pin-first-wins,
pin(None) never yields the string "None", mark-once wallet init).
Command: python -X utf8 tests/run_all.py -q

Synthetic identity integration, verified live on MCBETestServer
(BDS 1.26.45, Endstone 0.11.10, arc_core 0.9.82):
- identities.json holds one stable 16-digit 9-prefixed xuid + uuid5
  per bot (3 crowd cards + assistant TianXing).
- arc_core DB player_basic_info: one row per bot keyed by synthetic
  xuid alongside the real player's row; player_economy wallets carry
  each card's initial money (120/260/80).
- Root causes fixed along the way:
  1) str(None).strip() == "None" is truthy — pin() and crowd_spawn
     both produced xuid="None" before the normalization fix;
  2) PlayerJoinEvent does NOT fire for SimulatedPlayers in this
     Endstone build — arc_core's join init never ran for bots; the
     plugin now calls ensure_player_data_initialized itself when a
     body attaches (_ensure_core_identity);
  3) arc_core get_player_money_by_xuid is get-or-create, so wallet
     "first time" is decided by a one-shot marker in the identity
     registry (no free money on every rotation).
